hero.lead: A space to breathe, all year round.
hero.subtitle: Recurring, inspiring activities in a safe and cosy place, open to the community and to anyone passing through.
hero.imageAlt: A woman draws a heart on the misted window, facing the snowy mountains

inauguration.body: Irise opens its doors: come and meet the space, the people and the activities that will fill it all year round.

newsletter.title: Stay in touch

confirmation.body: Every now and then we'll write to you with the activity calendar, new workshops and the opening-day details.
confirmation.unsubscribe: If you no longer want our emails, reply to this message and we'll take you off the list.

confirm.description: One click and you're on the Irise newsletter list.
